result.title: SFT Leaves a Reproducible Signature in Activation Geometry: Calibrating Post-Training Interpretability Against Run-to-Run Noise
result.summary: A model diff credits post-training with whatever separates a base checkpoint from one post-trained descendant, presuming a rerun would land close by. On the sparse co-activation graph of Qwen3-1.7B it does not: two LoRA-SFT reruns sit over half as far apart as either sits from the base. We score each base-to-post contrast against the run-to-run band of its own recipe, and show that $k$ runs certify no better than $p=1/(k+1)$ under run exchangeability, however large the effect, so the band $z$-score is a descriptive scale. SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature: base $\to$ SFT displaces the graph by 17.8 pairwise-distance SDs beyond the mean distance between four independent LoRA-SFT runs, and the pre-registered estimator replicates on Llama-3.1-8B with Llama-Scope. At 29 steps each, four SFT and four DPO runs occupy disjoint displacement ranges, a gap $5.0\times$ and $5.6\times$ the spreads of the two arms, without any band. All bands use graphs built on one GPU architecture. Three other readings stop short of a verdict: DPO band counts (3/4, 1/4, 3/4 contrasts outside at 12, 29, 60 steps) show no consistent dose ordering while its displacement stays flat; light GRPO is a secondary non-detection, not an absence, and we run no equivalence test; and the graph concentration read as an RL signature is already in the zero-RL base. A pre-registered causal sweep at three edge budgets on 4,816 held-out prompts found the displaced sources load-bearing ($12\times$ a matched random control in mean, $3.5\times$ in median at 10,000 edges), but their stage-specificity interaction reversed at two budgets and the third failed its faithfulness gate, so we claim calibrated structural displacement, not a changed mechanism. Scope: one backbone, one SFT recipe and general-text probe states for the full protocol.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在 Qwen3-1.7B 的稀疏共激活图上测量 base→SFT 的位移，用多次 LoRA-SFT 重跑之间的差异作为噪声带做校准，认为 SFT 留下可复现的结构位移，而 DPO/GRPO 的读数未形成一致结论；再用预注册的因果扫描检验被位移的来源是否真正承担作用，并主动把结论限定为「经校准的结构位移」而非机制改变。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以重跑噪声校准内部表示层面的发现」与「用因果扫描判断被位移成分是否 load-bearing」两条做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态或视觉证据的因果贡献、贡献分配与解释稳健性；但研究对象是纯文本模型的后训练分析，不含视觉或多模态推理，属方法线索而非主线工作。
